name: Unresolved Structure Lifecycle Registry
purpose: Define the lifecycle transitions, escalation rules, and closure conditions for unresolved structures.

critical_transitions.condition: metastable behavior shown to be structurally emergent
symbolic scaffold implementation reveals fixable gaps
false stability confirmed as irreducible risk
repair achieves local validity but global closure is blocked
unresolvedness mapped to fundamental model incompleteness

governance_rules: Failure to achieve closure does not imply invalidity if bounded preservation conditions remain satisfied.
Unresolvedness is an evolving admissibility state, not a binary solved/unsolved object.
Transitions must be accompanied by updated failure geometry or scope constraint links.
